title: Remote workspace
idea: Remote workspace: Remote identity and sync state stay visible beside documents
audience: People who need to remote edit within a desktop surface.
worksWellWhen: Users edit across a network boundary
avoidWhen: Local and remote states cannot be separated
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its remote edit priority and explicit commitment contract: Do not overwrite remote changes without conflict review
navigation: Remote workspace keeps the current remote edit context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Remote identity and sync state stay visible beside documents
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to remote edit; users edit across a network boundary
composition.priority: Do not overwrite remote changes without conflict review

imagery.role: Support the actual remote edit context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Maintain offline draft markers on pane collapse
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the remote workspace structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no remote edit content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Do not overwrite remote changes without conflict review
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized remote edit content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Do not overwrite remote changes without conflict review
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active remote edit context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
